verdict.rationale: Per-environment configuration is a fair question for an infrastructure control plane like Crossplane, but the evidence pack shows no documented way to manage dev, staging and prod as separate stacks or workspaces. The closest item, "Environment Configs - In-memory data stores for Compositions", describes a composition data store, not per-environment stack or workspace separation, so it is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage per-environment configuration (dev, staging, prod) as separate stacks or workspaces
